items.t: Hive sets $500 million annual revenue run-rate goal for early 2027

items.t: Rosenblatt Maintains Buy on HIVE Digital Technologies, Lowers Price Target to $5

items.t: ​HIVE Digital Q2: Narrowing Discount To Peers Calls For Better Execution Proof (Downgrade)
How HIVE added more mining power in six months than most miners add in years
items.sum: HIVE Digital Technologies CEO Aydin Kilic says a 300 MW buildout in Paraguay, including a site bought from Bitfarms, let the miner more than triple its hash rate while rivals pulled back.
